fields.statement: Verified at ddf1ad2d. Read the diffs of 268eb67f and ddf1ad2d: healthCache in internal/api/web_daemon.go serves the held report and starts a background refresh only when none is running and the report is missing or older than 30 s; running, paused and slots still come from runDaemonStatus on every call; the template shows a pending pill until the first report. TestWebDaemonHealthCachedInBackground (internal/api/web_daemon_test.go) blocks the health read until released and asserts / and /fragments/daemon each answer under 400 ms, pending (not failed) pills first, 20 concurrent requests start exactly one refresh (now waiting for it to start, fixing attempt 1's flake), the report shows once it lands, and a report a minute old is served to 5 requests while exactly one new refresh starts and its result then shows. Ran the attempt-1 repro `go test -trimpath -c -race -o api.test ./internal/api && api.test -test.run TestWebDaemon -test.count=300 -test.cpu 1,2,4,8` twice: 1200 PASS, 0 FAIL each. `go test -trimpath -race -count=1 ./internal/web/...` passed; `go vet ./internal/api ./internal/web` clean.
